description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the ImmutableHashSet<T> type in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It provides conversion methods, surrogate definitions, and deep copy implementations for ImmutableHashSet<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableHashSet<T>, converting to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate data type holding list of values and comparer, used for serialization of ImmutableHashSet<T>.

classes.name: ImmutableHashSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier implementation for ImmutableHashSet<T> supporting deep copy operations.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts ImmutableHashSet<T> to its surrogate form.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableHashSet<T>.
